title: action policy.sync: data
description: (1.1) The hub's policy for one bound room, mirrored at the connector and acked by v. full=true replaces the whole mirror; otherwise each present field replaces that field and absent fields stay. Hidden and opted-out identities are HmacIds keyed by hidden_kid, for the connector's own platform only. The connector enforces it at the edge (spec/PCP.md, Security and privacy) and treats a mirror older than hello.bridge.policy_ttl_ms as stale.

bans.description: Feature bans that apply in this room, for identities on the connector's platform.

hidden.description: Identities whose lines, stickers, transcripts, captions and turn audio never leave the connector (dropped before anything is logged, recorded, remembered or transcribed).

hidden_kid.description: Id of the HMAC key the identity lists use. Keys are provisioned out of band with the connector credentials and never travel in PCP frames; each key has its own kid. A mirror naming a kid the connector does not hold is stale (stale_policy). Required whenever an identity list is present.

switches.description: Per-room switches (hub-defined names, e.g. relay, transcripts, captions, clips, whispers). The connector records nothing and runs no speech-to-text where a switch is off.

cmd_deny.description: Commands the connector's bot must not run in this room.
